senses.gloss: pr. n. pl.(b. h. לֹד)Lod, Lydda in South Palestine (Roman name Diospolis).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Maaser Sheni 5:2">Maas. Sh. V, 2</cite> <he>ל׳ מן המערב</he> Lod was the westernmost term (of one day’s journey from Jerusalem). Tosef. Erub. IX (VI), 2.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 1:1:7">Y. Meg. I, 70ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>ל׳ … מוקפות וכ׳</he> Lod and Ge Haḥarashim belong to the fortified towns of the conquest days (v. <cite ref="J00135"><he>יְהוֹשׁוּעַ</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 4:3">B. Mets. IV, 3</cite> <he>תגרי ל׳</he> the merchants of L.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 32b:8">Snh. 32ᵇ</cite> <he>אחר ר׳ אליעזר לל׳</he> follow R. El. to L.; a. fr.
